# `aube cat-file`

- **Usage:** `aube cat-file <HASH>`
- **Effect:** read-only

Print a file from the global store by integrity or hex hash

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/node-modules) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Arguments

- **`<HASH>`** — File hash to look up.

  Accepts `sha512-<base64>` (pnpm integrity format) or a raw hex CAS digest.

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help
